frontend.purpose: Future local dashboard for artifact review, state movement, audits, and model switching.

backend.purpose: Future HTTP API around artifacts, states, skills, providers, audits, and exports.

database.purpose: Generated index and dashboard acceleration layer. Markdown/YAML remains source of truth.

vector-index.purpose: Future retrieval for approved memory candidates and raw evidence.
vector-index.activation_condition: Only after filesystem lookup becomes too slow or memory reuse becomes frequent.

local-agent.purpose: Local agent bridge for OpenClaw or similar tools.

upstream-mercury-agent.purpose: Compatibility adapter for cosmicstack-labs/mercury-agent runtime iteration without making this repository a fork.

memory-migration.purpose: Reversible migration of approved artifact sediment into upstream or future memory architectures.
